$comment: Canonical MCP roster for building this product. Copy into the tool-specific config (Claude Code: `claude mcp add`; Codex: config.toml; Cursor: .cursor/mcp.json). No credential lives in this file. The load-bearing question is only whether the agent can observe the result of its own work: `playwright` answers it for the UI, `openrouter` answers it for the model roster. Fallback ladder when a server is unavailable: CLI in a shell (`npx playwright test`, `python scripts/refresh_models.py`) -> documented manual step in the plan file.

playwright.$purpose: See the running UI: navigate, snapshot, screenshot at the gauntlet's 1440x900 and 390x844 viewports. Point it at http://localhost:5273 (Playwright's own Vite server, proxying to the SYNTHETIC backend on :8099).

openrouter.$purpose: The live model catalogue: list-models with max_price=1.0 and supported_parameters=tools is the roster rule from 05-model-registry.md; get-generation reconciles a real run's cost. OAuth token lasts exactly seven days with no refresh; re-authenticate in-session when the tools disappear.

$deploy: No deploy MCP is configured. Render deploys on push to main (autoDeploy: yes on both services, render.yaml); the fallback is the Render dashboard, documented in docs/deploying.md.
$database: No database MCP is configured. Local runs use SQLite at output/validator-studio.db; production PostgreSQL 18 is reachable only from the singapore region (ipAllowList is empty). Two-writer contention tests (remaining-work item 3) need a local PostgreSQL, documented in 15-persistence.md.
